title: The Lost City of Tzalan

verbs.none:
NOTHING TO
DO HERE.
KEEP
EXPLORING.

system.dark:
IT IS TOO
DARK TO SEE.

intro:
LEGENDS
TELL OF A
CITY OF
GOLD, LOST
IN THE
JUNGLE FOR
A THOUSAND
YEARS.

AN OLD MAP
HAS LED YOU
TO THE EDGE
OF THE
JUNGLE.

YOUR CAMP
IS READY.

FIND THE
CITY. WAKE
ITS KINGS.

GOOD LUCK,
EXPLORER.

cells.name: Reed marsh
cells.desc:
YOU SQUELCH
THROUGH A
REED MARSH.
cells.look:
TALL DRY
REEDS, GOOD
FOR A TORCH.
THE MUD TO
THE WEST
BUBBLES.

take.text:
YOU BIND A
BUNDLE OF
REEDS INTO A
TORCH. IT IS
NOT LIT.

verbs.text:
LOOK
CLOSELY,
THEN TAKE A
REED TORCH.

cells.name: Base camp
cells.desc:
YOUR CAMP
SITS IN A
JUNGLE
CLEARING.
INSECTS
BUZZ.
cells.look:
TENTS AND A
CRACKLING
CAMPFIRE. A
MACHETE IS
STUCK IN A
STUMP.

verbs.text:
YOU HOLD THE
REEDS IN THE
CAMPFIRE.
THEY CATCH!
NOW YOU HAVE
A TORCH.
verbs.fail:
THE CAMPFIRE
CRACKLES.
YOU HAVE
NOTHING TO
LIGHT.

verbs.text:
LOOK
CLOSELY,
THEN TAKE A
MACHETE.
THEN TRY TO
LIGHT.

cells.name: River landing
cells.desc:
YOU ARE AT
THE RIVER
LANDING.
cells.look:
YOUR CANOE
IS TIED UP
HERE. A COIL
OF ROPE LIES
IN IT.

take.text:
YOU SLING
THE ROPE
OVER YOUR
SHOULDER.

verbs.text:
LOOK
CLOSELY,
THEN TAKE
SOME ROPE.

cells.name: Parrot clearing
cells.desc:
YOU ARE IN A
SUNNY
CLEARING.
cells.look:
A RED PARROT
WATCHES YOU
FROM A
BRANCH.

talk.no:
THE PARROT
SQUAWKS:
"MOON BY
NIGHT! SUN
BY DAY! GOLD
FOR THE
GUARDIAN!"

cells.name: Supply tent
cells.desc:
YOU ARE IN
THE SUPPLY
TENT.
cells.look:
EMPTY
CRATES. ONE
CORN CAKE IS
LEFT IN A
TIN.

take.text:
YOU WRAP UP
THE CORN
CAKE.

verbs.text:
LOOK
CLOSELY,
THEN TAKE A
CORN CAKE.

cells.name: Stream
cells.desc:
YOU SPLASH
ACROSS A
COOL STREAM.
cells.look:
BRIGHT FROGS
SIT ON THE
STONES. ONE
CROAKS AT
YOU.

talk.no:
THE FROG
CROAKS. YOU
FEEL A
LITTLE
SILLY.

cells.name: Far bank
cells.desc:
YOU ARE ON
THE FAR BANK
OF THE
GORGE.
cells.look:
AN OLD STONE
ROAD LEADS
NORTH INTO
THE JUNGLE.

cells.name: Kapok tree
cells.desc:
A GIANT
KAPOK TREE
TOWERS OVER
YOU.
cells.look:
ITS ROOTS
ARE LIKE
WALLS. YOU
COULD CLIMB
IT.

verbs.text:
FROM THE TOP
YOU SEE
STONE TOWERS
FAR TO THE
NORTH!
verbs.done:
JUST JUNGLE,
AND THE
TOWERS TO
THE NORTH.

cells.name: Gorge edge
cells.desc:
YOU ARE AT
THE EDGE OF
A DEEP
GORGE.
cells.look:
A ROPE
BRIDGE HANGS
IN TATTERS.
YOU COULD
MEND IT WITH
ROPE.

use.text:
YOU TIE THE
ROPE ACROSS
THE GAP. THE
BRIDGE WILL
HOLD!

alt.look:
YOUR MENDED
BRIDGE SWAYS
OVER THE
GORGE.

verbs.text:
USE SOME
ROPE HERE.

cells.name: Quicksand
cells.desc:
THE MUD
SUCKS AT
YOUR BOOTS.
YOU SINK...
AND SINK...

cells.name: Overgrown trail
cells.desc:
YOU ARE ON
AN OVERGROWN
TRAIL.
cells.look:
THICK VINES
BLOCK THE
WAY NORTH.

use.text:
YOU HACK
THROUGH THE
VINES. THE
WAY NORTH IS
CLEAR!

alt.look:
CUT VINES
LIE
EVERYWHERE.
THE WAY
NORTH IS
OPEN.

verbs.text:
USE A
MACHETE
HERE.

cells.name: Fig tree
cells.desc:
YOU STAND
UNDER A HUGE
FIG TREE.
cells.look:
A CHEEKY
MONKEY SITS
ON A BRANCH.
SOMETHING
SHINY HANGS
ON ITS
COLLAR.

take.text:
YOU PICK UP
A CARVED
STONE KEY.

give.text:
THE MONKEY
GRABS THE
CAKE AND
DROPS THE
SHINY THING!

talk.no:
THE MONKEY
CHATTERS AND
STARES AT
YOUR PACK.
IT LOOKS
HUNGRY.

alt.look:
THE MONKEY
MUNCHES ITS
CAKE, VERY
PLEASED WITH
ITSELF.

verbs.text:
SOMEONE HERE
WANTS A CORN
CAKE.
THEN TAKE A
STONE KEY.

cells.name: Jungle path
cells.desc:
YOU FOLLOW A
NARROW
JUNGLE PATH.
cells.look:
STRANGE
BIRDS CALL.
THE PATH
RUNS NORTH.

cells.name: Riverbank
cells.desc:
YOU WALK
ALONG A
MUDDY
RIVERBANK.
cells.look:
A WATER
GOURD FLOATS
IN THE
SHALLOWS.

take.text:
YOU FILL THE
GOURD WITH
FRESH WATER.

cells.name: Avenue of kings
cells.desc:
YOU WALK THE
AVENUE OF
KINGS.
cells.look:
STONE KINGS
STARE DOWN.
A TEMPLE
STANDS WEST,
A PYRAMID
EAST.

cells.name: Bath house
cells.desc:
YOU ARE IN
THE OLD BATH
HOUSE.
cells.look:
DRY STONE
POOLS.
PAINTED FISH
SWIM ON THE
WALLS.

cells.name: Great plaza
cells.desc:
YOU ARE IN
THE GREAT
PLAZA OF
TZALAN.
cells.look:
SILENT
PYRAMIDS AND
TOWERS ALL
AROUND.
NOTHING
MOVES.

cells.name: Ruined shrine
cells.desc:
YOU FIND A
SMALL RUINED
SHRINE.
cells.look:
OFFERINGS OF
OLD SHELLS
LIE BEFORE A
BROKEN IDOL.

verbs.text:
THE SHRINE
SAYS:
TRAVELLER,
THE CITY
SLEEPS UNTIL
THE STAR
RETURNS.

cells.name: Waterfall
cells.desc:
A WATERFALL
ROARS INTO
THE GORGE.
cells.look:
WET ROCKS
LEAD UP
BEHIND THE
FALLING
WATER.

verbs.text:
YOU CLIMB
BEHIND THE
WATERFALL
AND FIND AN
OLD CARVING:
A STAR ABOVE
A THRONE.
verbs.done:
THE CARVING
OF THE STAR
IS STILL
THERE.

cells.name: City gate
cells.desc:
YOU STAND
BEFORE THE
GATE OF
TZALAN.
cells.look:
A HUGE STONE

WITH A
KEYHOLE.

use.text:
THE KEY
TURNS. THE
GREAT DOOR

verbs.text:
USE A STONE
KEY HERE.

cells.name: Garden of stone
cells.desc:
YOU ARE IN A
GARDEN OF
STONE.
cells.look:
STONE
FLOWERS AND
STONE BIRDS.
NOT A LIVING
THING GROWS
HERE.

cells.name: Stone road
cells.desc:
YOU WALK AN
ANCIENT
STONE ROAD.
cells.look:

JAGUARS LINE
THE WAY,
GREEN WITH
MOSS.

cells.name: Hunters' hide
cells.desc:
YOU FIND AN
OLD HUNTERS'
HIDE.
cells.look:
BONES AND
BROKEN
SPEARS.
NOBODY HAS
BEEN HERE
FOR
CENTURIES.

cells.desc:

THE MOON
SANCTUM.
cells.look:
A GOLDEN SUN
DISC RESTS
ON THE
ALTAR. ODD,
IN A MOON
TEMPLE!

take.text:
YOU LIFT THE
HEAVY SUN
DISC.

verbs.text:
LOOK
CLOSELY,
THEN TAKE A
SUN DISC.

cells.name: Moon hall
cells.desc:
YOU ARE IN
THE MOON
HALL.
cells.look:
SILVER MOONS
ARE PAINTED
ON THE
WALLS.

dark.text:
IT IS BLACK
AS NIGHT IN
HERE.

cells.name: Moon temple
cells.desc:
YOU STAND
BEFORE THE
MOON TEMPLE.
cells.look:
A ROUND
HOLLOW IS
CARVED IN
THE DOOR,
THE SIZE OF
A DISC.

use.text:
THE DISC
FITS! THE
TEMPLE DOOR
SLIDES OPEN.

verbs.text:
USE A MOON
DISC HERE.

cells.name: Sun pyramid
cells.desc:
YOU STAND AT
THE FOOT OF
THE SUN
PYRAMID.
cells.look:
ITS DOOR HAS
A ROUND
HOLLOW, THE
SIZE OF A
DISC.

use.text:
THE DISC
FITS! STONE
GRINDS AS
THE DOOR
OPENS.

verbs.text:
USE A SUN
DISC HERE.

cells.name: Market ruins
cells.desc:
YOU ARE IN
THE RUINED
MARKET.
cells.look:
BROKEN
STALLS. AN
OLD KNIFE
LIES AMONG
THE POTS.

take.text:
YOU TAKE THE
OLD KNIFE.
STILL SHARP!

verbs.text:
LOOK
CLOSELY,
THEN TAKE AN
OLD KNIFE.

cells.name: Explorer's tent
cells.desc:
YOU FIND A
RAGGED TENT.
cells.look:
AN OLD
EXPLORER
LIES HERE,
WEAK WITH
THIRST.

HE DRINKS
DEEPLY.
"BLESS YOU!
TAKE MY
JOURNAL. IT
MAY HELP."

alt.look:
THE EXPLORER
SLEEPS
PEACEFULLY,
HIS WATER
GOURD AT HIS
SIDE.

verbs.text:
THE JOURNAL
SAYS: THE
MOON OPENS
THE NIGHT
TEMPLE. THE
SUN OPENS
THE DAY.

cells.name: Overlook
cells.desc:
YOU STAND ON
A ROCKY
OVERLOOK.
cells.look:
MIST RISES
FROM THE
GORGE. FAR
NORTH,
TOWERS POKE
THROUGH THE
TREES.

cells.name: Priests' houses
cells.desc:
YOU ARE
AMONG THE
PRIESTS'
HOUSES.
cells.look:
PAINTED
WALLS SHOW
PRIESTS

GLOWING
STAR.

cells.name: Ball court
cells.desc:
YOU ARE IN
AN ANCIENT
BALL COURT.
cells.look:
STONE RINGS
HIGH ON THE
WALLS.
GLYPHS RUN
ALONG THE
FLOOR.

verbs.text:
THE GLYPHS
SAY: THE
GUARDIAN
BELOW TRADES
ONLY FOR
GOLD.
verbs.done:

TRADES ONLY
FOR GOLD.

cells.name: Library
cells.desc:
YOU ARE IN
THE HOUSE OF
BOOKS.
cells.look:
FOLDED BARK
BOOKS, MOST
TURNED TO
DUST.

verbs.text:
ONE BOOK
SURVIVES:
THE KINGS
SLEEP BELOW
THE LAKE,
GUARDED BY
THE OLD
WARRIOR.

cells.name: Aqueduct
cells.desc:
YOU WALK
ALONG A
CRUMBLING
AQUEDUCT.
cells.look:
ONCE IT
CARRIED

WHOLE CITY.
NOW IT
CARRIES
LEAVES.

THE TOP OF
THE SUN
PYRAMID.

AN ALTAR
WITH THE
SHAPE OF A
FACE CARVED

MASK IN THE
ALTAR. FAR
BELOW, WATER

alt.look:

MASK GLOWS
ON THE
ALTAR.

verbs.text:
USE A JADE
MASK HERE.

cells.name: Observatory

YOU STAND AT
THE FOOT OF
A ROUND
TOWER.
cells.look:
THE
OBSERVATORY.
ITS STAIRS
HAVE FALLEN,
BUT YOU
COULD CLIMB
THE STONES.

verbs.text:
YOU CLIMB
THE
CRUMBLING
TOWER. AT
THE TOP LIES
A SILVER
MOON DISC!
verbs.done:

MUST HAVE
LOOKED FINE

verbs.text:
TRY TO
CLIMB.

cells.name: Old well

YOU ARE
BESIDE AN
OLD WELL.

THE WELL IS
VERY DEEP. A

HANGS FROM A
TREE NEARBY.

YOU TIE THE
VINE TO THE

CAN CLIMB
DOWN NOW.
verbs.done:
THE VINE
HANGS DOWN
INTO THE
WELL.

verbs.text:
TRY TO
CLIMB.

cells.name: Pyramid stairs
cells.desc:
YOU CLIMB
THE STEEP
INNER
STAIRS.
cells.look:
HUNDREDS OF
STEPS LEAD
UP TO THE
SKY.

cells.name: Well bottom

THE BOTTOM

BLOWS FROM

BED.

WET STEPS
LEAD DOWN TO

BED.

YOU ARE IN
THE HALL OF
MASKS.
cells.look:
STONE FACES
LINE THE
WALLS. AT
THE END, A
GHOSTLY
FIGURE
WAITS.

THE
GUARDIAN'S

alt.look:

NODS. THE
GATE OF
STARS STANDS

verbs.text:
SOMEONE HERE
WANTS A GOLD
IDOL.

ROOM OF
TZALAN.

A GREAT
STONE

A
STAR-SHAPED
HOLLOW ABOVE

YOU SET THE
STAR STONE
ABOVE THE
THRONE.
LIGHT FLOODS
THE CITY.
TZALAN
AWAKENS!

verbs.text:
USE A STAR
STONE HERE.

cells.name: Star chamber
cells.desc:
YOU ARE IN
THE STAR
CHAMBER.
cells.look:

LIGHT
GLITTER IN

A GLOWING
STONE RESTS
ON A
PEDESTAL.

take.text:

STONE IS
WARM IN YOUR
HAND.

verbs.text:
LOOK
CLOSELY,
THEN TAKE A
STAR STONE.

cells.name: Chasm
cells.desc:
YOU STEP
INTO EMPTY
AIR AND FALL
INTO THE
CHASM!

cells.desc:
YOU ARE IN A

BONES.
cells.look:

THOSE WHO

cells.name: Mushroom grotto
cells.desc:

GLOWING
GROTTO.
cells.look:

LIGHT.

cells.name: Hidden vault
cells.desc:
YOU ARE IN A
HIDDEN
VAULT.
cells.look:
A BEAUTIFUL
JADE MASK

STONE SHELF.

verbs.text:
LOOK
CLOSELY,
THEN TAKE A
JADE MASK.

cells.desc:
YOU ARE ON

LAKE BED.

THE WATER IS
FAR TOO

verbs.text:
LOOK

THEN TAKE A

CRYSTAL
CAVE.

print.story:
For a thousand years the jungle has hidden Tzalan, the city of gold. Its kings sleep, waiting for a star to return to its throne.

An old map has led you to the edge of the jungle. Your camp is ready. Somewhere to the north, beyond the gorge and the vines, the city waits.
print.notes:
Look at everything, and talk to everyone you meet: the jungle is full of clues. READ any glyphs you find, and CLIMB when something looks climbable. If you get stuck, try HINT.

The game is long. Use CODE to save your place.
